naming: Near = closer to the viewer (viewer-left: near ear, near arm in front of the tail, near leg); Far = turned away (viewer-right)

head.note: Face/head incl. stripes, cheeks, pinkish-beige bottom band; bottom = colour edge vs collar / tail / arm tops / background; near-ear + tuft junctions = AI-continued outline (ai_no_ears); far-ear junction = colour edge (ear brown vs head tan).

tuft.note: Cowlick blobs above the AI-continued head outline + their soft lower shading over the head.

earNear.note: Viewer-left (near) ear: original px outside the ai_no_ears head outline + inner-oval px clipped by it.

earFar.note: Viewer-right (far) ear (cand4 transplant, step 1): solid ear-brown disc by colour (exact edge vs head tan) + white-blended rim.

torso.note: Body incl. collar band, belly, crotch; bounded by arm shading edges, hip cuts, tail mask, head band.

pendant.note: Acorn only (olive cap+stem, green nut, highlights) by colour in the pendant window, holes filled.

armNear.note: Torso-side (right) edge of the arm's underside shading wedge per row, continued straight up to the collar; collar shadow on the shoulder included; outer side bounded by the AI tail mask.

armFar.note: Torso-side (left) edge of the far arm's inner shading stripe per row, continued straight up to the collar; below the hand a vertical line (torso side).

legNear.note: Hip cut: straight line from the outer silhouette (y=880) to the top-left corner of the gap between the legs, then down the gap.

legFar.note: Gap top-right corner -> along the top edge of the inner-thigh shading crescent to its tip -> straight to the outer silhouette at y=880.

tail.note: Pixels changed by ai_no_tail AND non-green in ai_tail_only (incl. the dark stripe sliver visible between the near hand and the torso).
